# CatFrame - 0.10.11

## What is changed?
Change version number from previous to `0.10.11`

### ➕Add:
- Implement blockstate uvlock. Parse path already existed (BlockstateJson.Variant.uvlock); now threaded through the bake pipeline. JsonModelBake.applyUvLock re-derives each rotated quad's UV from its world position per the final facing (mirrors vanilla FaceBakery.lockVertexUv), so geometry turns but the texture stays world-locked. UnbakedModel gains a default bake(...,uvlock) overload; ModelJsonUnbakedAdapter applies the lock only when a non-zero rotation is present. uvlock is plumbed through ModelBaker/BakingCore and encoded into the BakedModelCache key via a trailing '!' marker (lazy-baked; async pre-bake keeps plain keys). Consumers (ResidentStateModel, RenderDispatcher, StateProviderBlockModel) pass variant.uvlock.
- Add chunk-boundary render refresh on chunk load (IWorldAccess notification bypass). Vanilla 1.7.10 only re-marks neighbour sections on chunk UNLOAD (WorldClient.doPreChunk false branch); both client chunk handlers (NetHandlerPlayClient.handleChunkData S21 / handleMapChunkBulk S26) mark only the received chunk's own range after fillChunk, so connection geometry across chunk seams stays stale until an unrelated block update. New client-only MixinNetHandlerPlayClient injects at the handler TAILs (block data already filled, deferred rebuild reads it next render pass) and emits four one-block-wide World.markBlockRangeForRenderUpdate strips hugging the loaded column; the +/-1 section dilation is vanilla's own RenderGlobal.markBlocksForUpdate behaviour, and the unload path is skipped. Registered under Mixins.RENDERING.
- Add unit tests for the joinCode staticization work: stateIndexOf injectivity/domain/-1 bypass and static-property participation, MultipartWhen precomputed split with fallback equivalence, BakedModelCache generation bump, ResidentStateModel memo identity/exclusion/rebuild; set compileTestJava UTF-8 encoding
- Memoize merged blockstate parts by full cartesian-product state index (joinCode): add BlockStateDefinition.stateIndexOf with -1 bypass, ResidentStateModel per-target part memo with weighted-array exclusion, and BakedModelCache generation counter to invalidate memos on reload
   - WorldTranslucentPasses (new): marks blocks whose BLOCK_WORLD part contains force-translucent quads, maintains a per-thread chunk-tessellation scope, sequence-pairs getRenderBlockPass -> canRenderInPass -> render to carry the current tessellation pass (0 solid / 1 alpha), and coalesces first-time discoveries into a deferred loadRenderers rebuild on client tick end. clear() drops marks on model re-registration so a hijack never outlives its model.
   - MixinBlock (new): base-only, narrow-gate injections. getRenderBlockPass returns 1 for marked blocks (so the pass loop compiles an alpha mesh); canRenderInPass(opts the solid pass 0 back in for the paired block). Blocks overriding these themselves (native glass, GTNH-style multi-pass) dispatch to their subclass body first and stay untouched. canRenderInPass is a Forge-patched method (no SRG name in prod), so it is targeted with remap=false rather than an extraMappings srg entry.
   - JsonModelBake: add per-quad BakedQuad.forceTranslucent; new bakeElement overload taking a force-variable set; an element is force-translucent as a whole when any face references a flagged variable (element granularity per spec). deepCopyQuad copies the flag.
   - BlockStateModelPart: add translucentSplit() (solid vs force-translucent sub-parts, zero-allocation when homogeneous), mirroring atlasSplit.
   - Add canonicalKey(): bare paths default to the minecraft namespace, builtin/ passes through.

# CatFrame - 0.10.10

## What is changed?
Change version number from previous to `0.10.10`

### ➕Add:
- Phase 4c: finish per-property meta byte-mapping migration. Add TableMetaProperty<V> (non-linear raw->value lookup table + fallback) for String-valued blocks. Restate remaining vanilla positional MetaCodec sites to distributed byte mapping: sand/wall (clamp), dirt/tallgrass/quartz_block (raw tables), yellow_flower (constant), and both comparators (facing+mode+powered bit fields). Decodes are byte-identical to the prior lambdas.
- Stage 4 (parts A+B) of blockstate refactor: restate VanillaStateDefinitions using property-level metadata byte mapping, removing the internal positional MetaCodec lambdas. Part A: linear/bit-field/clamp blocks (base pillar/stairs/slab, logs, single-variant clamps, stone/wooden/double slabs, anvil, red_flower, double_plant, trapdoor, door, cauldron, redstone wire, repeaters, pistons, fence gate, pumpkins) now use MappedMetaProperty/BooleanFlagProperty/EnumMetaProperty<Direction.Axis> so each property decodes its own bit field (no .metaCodec). Part B: non-linear facing tables (torch/redstone_torch, lever, ladder, dispenser/dropper, button, furnace, hopper) migrated to EnumMetaProperty.withTable over Direction, plus a new TorchFacing enum for the ground-standing case; powered/open flags use BooleanFlagProperty. Coexists with the legacy positional codec (kept for the residual coupled/constant blocks) which still takes precedence.
- Add GTNHLib-style meta-property foundation (Stage 1 of blockstate refactor): new StringRepresentable interface implemented by Direction/Axis; Property gains value<->name codec (getName(T)/getValueByName) with Boolean/Integer/Enum overrides; new MetaBlockProperty base plus BooleanFlagProperty, IntegerRangeProperty, MappedMetaProperty, EnumMetaProperty to push metadata byte-mapping down to each property. Purely additive, compileJava passes.

### 🔧Fix:
- Fix container data-slot sync in AbstractContainerMenu: override updateProgressBar to write S31PacketWindowProperty values back into ContainerData on the client; restore vanilla mode-1 guards in onQuickMove (slot -999 drop, negative index/button rejection, canTakeStack check) to prevent server-side OOB and slot-restriction bypass; push full data-slot state to newly attached ICrafting listeners in addCraftingToCrafters like vanilla ContainerFurnace.
- Stage 3 of blockstate refactor: BlockStateInheritance.resolve now detects distributed byte mapping — when every static (non-dynamic) merged property is a MetaBlockProperty, inheritance becomes a plain property union with no whole-definition MetaCodec, so multi-fragment merging no longer requires positional codec splicing (each property decodes only its own bit field). The legacy positional mergeCodecs path and its missing-codec warning are preserved and still used when any static property is not a MetaBlockProperty, keeping un-restated vanilla definitions working until Stage 4.

### ❗❗❗Deprecated:
- Remove now-unused private helpers singleVariant(...) and clampCodec(...) from the vanilla state definitions; every block has been migrated to per-property meta byte mapping, so their only callers are gone.

# CatFrame - 0.10.9

## What is changed?
Change version number from previous to `0.10.9`

### ➕Add:
    - /execute added
- mcfuntion added
- Rewrite AbstractSilderButton comments to English-only per the Java comment convention: drop all Chinese paragraphs from class/method JavaDoc and inline comments, keeping the porting notes (narration/cursor omitted, InputType focus approximation, sound-on-release) and implementation mapping details intact.
- Complete bilingual JavaDoc coverage in AbstractSilderButton: add English counterpart paragraphs to every Chinese-only comment block (class porting notes, renderWidget, mouse/key handlers, setFocused, setValueFromMouse, setValue) per the English-comment convention.
- Implement AbstractSilderButton slider logic ported from 26.1.2 AbstractSliderButton: nine-patch track/handle rendering via TextureStretching.drawAutoNinePatch driven by mcmeta, scrolling centered message with TEXT_MARGIN clamping, mouse click/drag/release value setting with press sound on release, keyboard stepping (Enter toggles canChangeValue, arrows step by 1/(width-8)), and focus-driven canChangeValue (InputType approximation on 1.7.10). Narration and cursor requests are not portable to 1.7.10 and are documented as omitted.

### 🔧Fix:
    - fix refmap names
- fix some clean up
- fix button tooltip sticking below widget after click
- Rewrite the Data Pack row in README: describe the datapack pipeline (tiered discovery, pack.mcmeta metadata, enable/disable state, pluggable content loaders, apply-pass error reports, login/broadcast snapshot sync); fix the DataPackReposotry typo to DataPackRepository

### ❗❗❗Deprecated:
    - No deprecations
